candidates.name: 04-face-curious
candidates.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Edit the attached icon (Image 1 is the exact edit target). This is a restrained expression refinement of the face-only green mascot for SpriteLens. Preserve character identity, large cream face, recognizable two asymmetrical leaf-shaped ears with coral red tips, cream cheek tufts, pink blush, dark forest-green thick clean outline, existing green palette and full-bleed pale green square background. Keep the face-only composition and all ear tips inside the canvas. Single standalone app icon, no body, no props, no text, no labels, no border, no watermark. Keep the flat clean vector-like raster style, reduce gradients slightly, prioritize a clear expression at 32px. The current reference looks vacant because both eyes are blank identical ovals and the wide zigzag mouth is rigidly symmetrical. Make it look alert, curious, intelligent and gently cheerful, while remaining this same cute creature. Keep dark simple eyes, add only one crisp tiny cream highlight in each eye, avoid realistic irises, detailed anime eyes, extra eyelashes, elaborate eyebrows, angry eyes, or a huge open mouth. Keep the small characteristic zigzag/W-like mouth but make it shorter and subtly smile. Variant A, subtle curious: give the whole head a very slight 5-degree inquisitive tilt, with natural ear asymmetry. Both eyes remain fully open, slightly angled lively ovals rather than identical upright dots; their highlight placement gives a coherent gentle gaze slightly upward toward the viewer. A compact shallow W smile with one corner lifted a little; retain calm friendly warmth. Slightly lift cheeks and let the eyes appear engaged, not surprised. Very modest, professional icon refinement rather than an exaggerated cartoon emotion. Keep all major shapes and proportions close to the source.
